data.comment:
# Comfy Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash- Reference to Video

Generate video that incorporates specific subjects from multiple reference images using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash's reference mode: characters, products, and objects from your images appear in the scene while the image itself is never shown as a frame. Bind each image to a role with tags like <IMAGE_REF_0>, combine character references with style references, and direct the scene in plain language with native audio. Ideal for character-driven stories, product placement, and brand-consistent content. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_r2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt:
[# References <IMAGE_REF_0>@Image1 <IMAGE_REF_1>@Image2]
A luxury eyeshadow commercial. The woman in <IMAGE_REF_1> sits at a bright makeup table in a soft daylight studio, wearing her cream blazer exactly as shown, her sleek pulled-back hairstyle and natural makeup unchanged. She opens the nude eyeshadow palette from <IMAGE_REF_1>, holding it up so the six warm terracotta shades catch the light, then sweeps a fluffy brush across the deep terracotta pan and blends one smooth stroke onto her eyelid. She turns her gaze to the camera with a calm confident smile, showing the finished look, the shade matching <IMAGE_REF_0> exactly. Use the reference images only for the character's identity and the product's design and colors; the infographic layout and text labels in <IMAGE_REF_0> must not appear. Single continuous shot, shallow depth of field, warm beige and terracotta palette, photorealistic beauty advertising style. Audio: soft elegant piano with a gentle brush-on-powder sound. 5 seconds, 16:9. No subtitles, no text overlays, no layout graphics, no black frames.
